scientific_integrity: All-time analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational identities; sampled numerical tests are supplementary, not proof. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact complex-admissible one-state H2 classification only for equal positive residues and opposite real stable modes.
The physical transfer function is delayed by one sample; the normalized delay-free factor has the same H2 error.
No result on general higher-order or unequal-residue transfer functions, finite-horizon fitting or numerical convergence.
title: Sharp symmetry breaking in one-state \(H_2\) reduction of an opposite-pole system
